Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (he stands up and starts to pace around the room) You're just trying to poison me! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not thinking clearly. Just take the pills, please 🙏.

JACK:
(suddenly calm) No. I won't take them. But I'll prove they're safe. (he looks at Dr. Smith with a mischievous grin) Watch this. (he holds out his hand, and Dr. Smith hesitantly takes it)

DR. SMITH:
(surprised) What are you doing, Jack?

JACK:
(smiling) I'm showing you that they're safe. (he takes the pills from Dr. Smith's pocket and hands them back to him) Here. Take them. Prove it to yourself 🤔.

DR. SMITH:
(hesitant) Okay... (he takes the pills and swallows them down)

As Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he's met with an empty space where Jack was sitting 🤯. He looks around the room, confused, and that's when he sees it: a figure standing in the corner, watching him 👀.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) Jack? Is that you?

The figure doesn't respond. Instead, it starts to fade away, revealing a figure that looks uncannily like Dr. Smith himself 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(alarmed) No... no, no, no... (he stumbles backward, tripping over his own feet) I... I'm the one who's been delusional all along 🤯.

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith falls to the ground, surrounded by the empty space where Jack was, and the figure that was once Jack now standing in the corner, watching him 👻.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
